articles.description: Fossils suggest Spriggina floundersi, an ancient marine organism, displayed population-level right-handedness. Researchers observed fossil impressions indicating a consistent directional preference during the organism's life. This suggests early neurological characteristics may have emerged much earlier than previously believed.

articles.title: After the 2011 tsunami, Japan spent billions building towering concrete seawalls along its coast, but scientists now say many of the barriers disrupted coastal habitats, cut off beaches from the sea and hindered natural shoreline recovery
